versions.content: Routing of ISignalIPdu s that are part of a Multi- plexedIPdu ISignalIPdu s that are part of a MultiplexedIPdu (static or dynamic) and are also handled by the Com module shall have a PduTrigger- ing and IPduPort s since they are handled by the PduR (and Com). Especially it is allowed to ignore certain received parts of a MultiplexedIPdu in a specific ECU.
